who: Charles W. McCurdy, legal historian at the University of Virginia; PhD UC San Diego, 1976.

evidence.says: UVA identifies Charles W. McCurdy as a history professor emeritus specializing in legal history, with a UC San Diego PhD in 1976.
The law school reports that Charles McCurdy joined the history department in 1975 and the law faculty in 1979.
LC identifies Charles W. McCurdy through The Fields and the Law (1986), consistent with the UVA legal historian.

notes: The full name, legal-history field, institution and exact doctorate match identify the Charles W. candidate.

who: Anthony (Tony) Michels, historian of American Jewish history at the University of Wisconsin–Madison; PhD Stanford, 1998.

evidence.says: The Wisconsin faculty directory lists Anthony E. Michels as a history professor with a Stanford PhD in 1998.
Stanford identifies Tony Michels as the University of Wisconsin professor of American Jewish history and author of A Fire in Their Hearts.
The candidate authority is for André Michels, citing Homme et sujet and Psychoanalyse nach 100 Jahren.
The association identifies André Michels as a practicing psychoanalyst and co-editor of Jahrbuch für klinische Psychoanalyse.

notes: The sole candidate is André Michels, a different author in psychoanalysis; it is not Anthony/Tony Michels.
